# Database URL Configuration

The function `database_url` retrieves the database URL from the environment variable `KC_DATABASE_URL`. If not set, it falls back to a default PostgreSQL connection string. This feature allows dynamic configuration of the database connection based on the environment.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/storage/db.py` — `knowledge_compiler.storage.db.database_url`
